name_en: THE RULES EVERY BOSS CLIP OBEYS — paste these blocks into every prompt below
what_this_is: These prompts describe the boss's own body as it already moves in src/art/boss.js today: one painted still (src/assets/boss/magmaroth.webp) warped by a mesh rig whose channels are breath, swing, lean, twist, jaw, headX, headY, charge, crouch, shove and wob. Every beat and every number below is read off that file, not invented.
identity_en: The creature is Magmaroth, exactly as in the reference still and never redesigned: a hulking bipedal brute, hunched forward, hide of dark violet-black scale over a bronze-gold chest and belly, enormous shoulders plated in gold pauldrons that curve up into two horns each, gold bracers on both forearms, four long black claws on each hand, a ridge of blood-red spines running down its back and tail, and no separate neck — a fanged maw sits sunk between its shoulders, with violet runes burning on the plate above it and a molten core glowing through the chest. A small pale-maned rider in a blue cloak sits on its shoulders holding a double-bladed axe; the rider stays seated for the whole clip, riding the motion a beat behind the body, never falling, never dismounting, never swinging the axe.
stage_en: The creature is alone on a flat, evenly lit chroma-key green studio backdrop — a seamless green studio cyclorama, the same solid green from edge to edge, and nothing else is in frame: no floor, no ground plane, no room, no landscape, no wall, no rock, no second creature, no prop, no shadow cast on the green. The green is a plain backdrop and is never lit by the creature: it does not brighten, glow, flicker, darken or change colour anywhere, and no green light spills onto the creature, whose scales stay violet-black, gold and blood red and are never tinted green.
framing_en: Full body in frame, seen front on at the creature's own chest height, centred, the feet planted in the bottom fifth of the frame and never leaving it, the pauldrons and the rider never cropped at the top, the same framing and the same distance from the first frame to the last. Square frame. Single continuous shot, one fixed locked-off camera, no cuts, no shot changes, no camera movement, no zoom, no push in, no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no shake, no parallax.
no_fx_en: Nothing is added around the creature: no fire, no lava, no breath, no projectile, no shockwave, no ground crack, no crater, no smoke, no dust, no flying rock, no sparks, no magic circle, no rune ring in the air, no motion trail, no speed lines, no impact flash filling the frame. Only the creature's own light changes — the runes on its chest plate, the core burning behind them, the eyes and the inside of the maw. The game composites every effect on top of this clip from its own sheets, so anything the creature throws must be absent from the plate.
loop_en: The clip starts and ends on exactly the same resting stance — weight on both feet, arms hanging, maw closed, body at its rest height — so it cuts straight back into the idle with no jump. One attack in the whole clip: no second swing, no repeat, no combo, nothing before it and nothing after it, and it is finished well before the clip ends.
never_en: No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no UI, no health bar, no lens flare, no bloom washing the whole frame, no vignette, no depth of field, no film grain, no motion blur smear, no extra limbs, no second head, no design change between frames.
black_swap_en: For the black-background variant, replace the stage block with: The creature is isolated on a pure flat black background, nothing else in frame — no floor, no ground plane, no room, no landscape, no wall, no rock, no second creature, no prop. Nothing in the frame is lit except the creature itself, and the background stays black from the first frame to the last.
references_en: 1. src/assets/boss/magmaroth.webp — IDENTITY: the exact creature, its proportions, its armour, its rider, its palette. Every frame has to be recognisably this model.
2. the game screenshot — STYLE ONLY: painted 3D mobile-RPG rendering, semi-realistic, high contrast, how light is painted. Never its board, gems, cards or layout.
3. src/art/boss.js — the motion itself: the pose channels, the timings and the easings quoted in every beat below.

name_en: IDLE — the stance every attack leaves from and returns to
target: the first and last frame of every clip below
beat: boss.update: a two-sine breath at rate 1.55 (2.9 enraged) scaling the body 1 +/- 0.026 vertically (0.042 enraged) with a volume-preserving counter-scale sideways, hs = 1 + (1 - vs) * 0.5. The head lags the body by 6.5 px at the same rate and drifts +/- 9 px sideways at 0.61. The rider counter-bobs 11 px against the body and drifts 8 px at 0.44. The feet are damped to 15 percent of the motion so they stay planted. The eyes flicker at 9.3 Hz and blink once every 3.2 s. Embers leave the chest core and the maw at 7 a second, 15 enraged.
prompt_en: Match the art style of the reference game screenshot exactly: painted 3D mobile-RPG game art, semi-realistic, high contrast, saturated colour with bright hot cores, no flat cartoon shading, no anime line art, no pixel art. Take only the rendering style from that screenshot; never its background, its board, its gems, its cards or any part of its layout. [IDENTITY] The creature stands and breathes and does nothing else. Its chest swells and settles in a slow heavy double rhythm, a little under two breaths a second, the body rising barely a fortieth of its height and spreading a touch wider as it sinks, so its bulk never changes. The huge shoulders carry the motion; the head hangs low between them and follows a beat late, drifting slowly from side to side; the arms hang at rest and sway with the shoulders; the clawed feet stay flat on the ground and never lift, never shuffle, never take a step. The rider on its shoulders rides the same rhythm a beat behind, settling as the body rises. The runes on the chest plate and the core behind them pulse slowly, the eyes flicker and blink once in the clip, and the maw stays closed. No attack, no lunge, no roar, no gesture, no turn, no look at the camera. [STAGE] [FRAMING] [NO_FX] The clip loops: the last frame matches the first exactly. [NEVER]

name_en: LAVA BREATH — the body that throws the cone, boss.lavaBreath(0.62)
beat: 0.00-0.26 s wind-up, quadOut: breath 0.86 (the body crushes to 86 percent of its height and widens), lean -18 weighted towards the shoulders, headY -26, jaw 0.10, charge 0.85 (runes and core up, a 3.4 px tremor through the frame). 0.26-0.40 s snap, backOut so it overshoots: breath 1.16, lean +34, headY +22, jaw 1 (the maw pulls 46 px down and flares 30 px wide, its light scaled 1.7x and 2.4x brighter), charge 1, wob 0.70 — a damped ripple, 16.5 Hz vertical and 13 Hz lateral, amplitude growing with height, decaying over about a second — and 14 embers leave the mouth at 340 px/s. 0.40-1.02 s hold with the maw wide, easing lean 34 to 24 and headY 22 to 16 as it pushes the gout out. 1.02-1.40 s recovery, quadOut back to rest, the glow down over 0.30 s.
prompt_en: Match the art style of the reference game screenshot exactly: painted 3D mobile-RPG game art, semi-realistic, high contrast, saturated colour with bright hot cores, no flat cartoon shading, no anime line art, no pixel art. Take only the rendering style from that screenshot; never its background, its board, its gems, its cards or any part of its layout. [IDENTITY] It breathes, once. From the resting stance it hauls its whole upper body backwards over a quarter of a second: the chest crushes down and spreads wider as it loads, the shoulders roll back, the head pulls back and up out from between them, the jaw cracks open a finger's width, the runes on the chest plate and the core behind them brighten as they fill, and a fine tremor runs through the whole body. Then in a seventh of a second it snaps forward and overshoots: the body stretches taller than its resting height, the shoulders drive out over the feet, the head thrusts forward and down, and the maw opens to its widest, the jaw dropping and flaring wide with the light in the throat going white. The instant it lands, a shudder travels up from the planted feet through the body, strongest at the shoulders and the rider, and dies out over the next second. It holds there with the maw wide for two thirds of a second, easing a little further forward as if pushing something out of itself, then closes the maw, draws the head back between the shoulders and settles to the resting stance over a third of a second while the rune light fades. The feet never move: they stay planted through the whole strike and the body pivots over them. The fire itself is never in frame — this is the body alone, the breath it throws is composited later. One breath, one beat: no second lunge, no repeat, no bite, no step forward. [STAGE] [FRAMING] [NO_FX] [LOOP] [NEVER]

Then in a seventh of a second it snaps forward and overshoots: the body stretches taller than rest, the shoulders drive out over the feet, the head thrusts forward and down, the maw opens to its widest with the throat going white. A shudder rides up from the planted feet through the shoulders and the rider and dies out. No fire in frame — the body alone, the breath is composited later. One breath, one beat, no second lunge. [STAGE] [FRAMING] [NO_FX] [LOOP] [NEVER]
note_en: If you ever want the gout baked into the clip instead, say so in the prompt and then drop vfx.cone and the breath sheet out of director.bossBreath, or the fire lands twice.

name_en: MAGMA SLAM — both fists into the ground, boss.smash()
beat: 0.00-0.30 s raise, quadOut: swing 0.95 (both arms up 195 px and in 46 px), breath 1.08, lean -16, headY -18, charge 0.45. 0.30-0.43 s hold at the top. 0.43-0.53 s drop, quadIn so it accelerates into contact: swing -0.45 (the arms drive 88 px below their rest), breath 0.82 (the body crushes and spreads), lean +34, headY +28, jaw 0.80. On contact the whole picture freezes for 0.06 s, wob 1 — the hardest ripple in the set — plus 12 rock shards and 22 dust puffs, which the engine draws, not the clip. 0.67-1.27 s elasticOut settle, overshooting rest twice before it lands.

Over the next two thirds of a second the body springs back towards its resting stance, overshooting it twice, smaller each time, before it settles. The feet stay planted through all of it. Nothing leaves the creature: no shockwave, no crater, no flying rock, no dust — the hands simply meet the ground and the body takes the recoil; the impact is composited later. One slam, one beat: no second blow, no repeat, no stomp, no step. [STAGE] [FRAMING] [NO_FX] [LOOP] [NEVER]
